jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant (f/m/d) - Grid Integration (Data-Consultant)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

 

Day In your new role as Senior Consultant (f/m/d) Grid Integration within our Grid Consulting team, you will be the driving force behind projects that guide our clients — from renewable developers and investors to grid operators — through their most critical decisions. Your day begins by connecting with a client who is w eighing an investment in a new renewable project: you listen, understand their ambitions, and translate them into a clear project roadmap spanning the early investment decision, Pre - FEED and FEED studies, grid code compliance, and — together with our partners — layout and basic design. As the face towards the customer, you own the relationship end - to - end. You are involved in acquir ing new opportunities, shape compelling proposals, and manage projects to successful delivery. Throughout the day you align our internal experts — from network studies specialists to design and commercial colleagues — orchestrating everyone toward a shared goal and ensuring the client always experiences one confiden t, coordinated Siemens Energy voice. You anticipate risks before they surface, keep stakeholders engaged and informed, and make sure every milestone moves the project closer to a sound, bankable outcome. No two days look the same: one moment you are steering a kick - off workshop, the next you are negotiating scope, mentoring colleagues, or presenting results that give a client the confidence to invest. You thrive on this variety — because you know that behind every project you lead stands a real contribution to the energy transition.

 

 

How You’ll Make an Impact

*  Own projects end - to - end   —   from the early investment decision through Pre - FEED and FEED studies   —   taking  full responsibility for scope, schedule, budget, and delivery quality
* Orchestrate cross - functional ,   multi - cultural   teams, aligning network studies specialists, grid code compliance  experts, design   experts , and commercial functions to deliver seamlessly against client expectations.   Manage  stakeholders proactively, anticipating risks, resolving interface and scope challenges early, and keeping all  parties informed and engaged
* Drive grid code compliance as a central thread throughout the project lifecycle, helping clients de - risk their  investments and secure bankable, compliant outcomes
*  Be the face towards the customer, building trusted, long - term relationships and ensuring every client  experiences one confident, coordinated Siemens Energy voice
*  Contribute to team growth by sharing knowledge, mentoring colleagues, and helping evolve our portfolio from  network studies toward holistic, lifecycle advisory

What You Bring

* University degree in electrical power engineering ( M.Sc . or Ph.D ) ,   additional qualifications such as MBA, or  project management certification (e.g., PMP, IPMA) are a strong plus
* Several years of professional experience in the power and energy sector   —   ideally in grid connection,  renewable integration, or transmission systems   —   combined with a proven track record in consulting,   network  studies ,   or   project   management
*  Advanced project management skills, with demonstrated success in leading complex, multi - stakeholder  projects from acquisition through delivery, managing scope, schedule, budget, and risk
* Solid technical understanding of grid code compliance   and   grid integration —   enough to engage credibly with  both clients and technical experts, even where you rely on specialists for the detail
* Knowledge of typical power system simulation programs (e.g. PSS ® E, PowerFactory,   PSS® NETOMAC,  PSCAD/EMTDC, Matlab/Simulink ) and   Real - Time simulation   is an added advantage
* Strong stakeholder management and communication abilities, comfortable being the primary customer  interface and aligning diverse internal teams and external partners toward shared goals
* Initiative, creativity, analytic and strategic thinking, teamwork, customer orientation and intercultural teams  characterize your preferred working environment 
* Fluent   English   and German   skills   (spoken   and   written);   O ther   languages are an   advantage   given our  international client base
* Willingness to travel occasionally to meet clients, partners, and colleagues across regions

About the Team 

Our Grid Technology team enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.00 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo 

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Berlin, Germany; Hamburg, Germany; Munich, Germany.

Minimum qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
- 2 years of experience in a technical project management or a customer-facing role.
- Experience in online advertising technology, online measurement, Search, data integration and cloud technologies.
- Experience with digital marketing trends and business issues related to Search Ads or Search Ads 360.
- Ability to communicate in German and English fluently to support stakeholders in this region.

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience with digital marketing trends and business issues related to Search Ads or Search Ads 360.

About the Job

gTech Ads is responsible for all support and media and technical services for  customers big and small across our entire Ad products stack. We help our  customers get the most out of our Ad and Publisher products and guide them when they need help. We provide a range of services from enabling better self help and in-product support, to providing better support through interactions, setting up accounts and implementing ad campaigns, and providing media solutions for customers business and marketing needs and providing complex technical and measurement solutions along with consultative support for our large customers. These solutions range from bespoke and customized ones for our customers to scalable support for millions of customers worldwide. Based on the evolving needs of our ads customers, we partner with Sales, Product and Engineering teams within Google to develop better solutions, tools, and services to improve our products and enhance our client experience. As a cross-functional and global team, we ensure our customers get the best return on investment with Google and we remain a trusted partner.

As a Solutions Architect (SA), you will create an excellent experience for Google’s Ads clients by being accountable for gTech service delivery,enabling sales objectives and own business goal attainment for particular your product area. You will serve as an unified service partner who designs and delivers gTech Ads solution and services across the whole Large Customer Sales (LCS) portfolio.

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

To learn more about gTech, check out our video.

- Advise Google’s Ads clients by understanding how Search, SA360 and bidding solutions can address their business issues, by acting as a collaborative and thought partner, architecting solutions and services plans to accomplish their goals, and effectively delivering on, technical, global projects.
- Discover customer needs by understanding clients annual and quarterly issues/goals in collaboration with sales, assessing and prioritizing where gTech Ads can add value and drive uplift, and securing executive client buy-in.
- Participate in ideation and design of a joint services plan by aligning solutions to client focus areas. Unlock new opportunities for growth by scoping projects.
- Deliver services and solutions working closely with other specialists and gTech Ads delivery teams in the region and the hub.
- Conduct regular debriefs with clients and Sales Teams, gathering insights on clients business objectives.

jobs.occupation: Working student (d/f/m) in Strategic Procurement (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working student (d/f/m) in Strategic Procurement

Are you a full-time student (d/f/m) looking for a working student position and would like to familiarise yourself with the work of strategic procurement? Then apply now! We would be delighted if you could support us in Strategic Aerostructure Procurement as a working student (d/f/m) for approx. 15 - 18 hours per week!

- Location: Manching
- Start: Immediately
- Duration: Approx. 12 months

Around 60% of the value of the Airbus Products comes from our external supply chain, composed from thousands of suppliers all over the world. The Procurement function is therefore a key contributor to the sustainable profitability and to the technical innovation of Airbus.

Definition working student
Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.
This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.
Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location
Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Traveling overseas or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Support our Procurement team with projects in Strategic Purchasing

- During tendering e.g. by setting up Non-Disclosure Agreements, request and evaluate offers and preparation of selection reports.
- During the set-up & management of contractual agreements with suppliers.

Opportunity to develop project management skills

- Generate project plans and set up adequate reporting schemes.
- Analyses of relevant KPIs.
- Active risk management of the relevant procurement perimeter.

Collaboration with strategic buyers and internal customers.

- Support the definition and update of the commodity strategy with market research, data analysis and supplier operational and strategic excellence evaluation
- Planning and executing small improvement projects

Required knowledge and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the field of business administration, engineering or economics.
- Confident handling of MS Office or Google Suite.
- First practical experience desirable.
- Business fluent in English, German desirable, all other additional languages are welcome.
- You are a team player, communicative and have an independent way of working.

Please upload the following documents in English or German: cover letter, CV, relevant certificates, certificate of enrolment.

Not a 100% match? No need to worry! Airbus supports your personal development.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

#MYCYM

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: In-Service Support Project Engineer (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Materialwissenschaften)
jobs.description:
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The BOXER 8x8 is the leading armoured vehicle with a multi-national user background that has been developed in a joint co-operation programme between Germany and the Netherlands by the international consortium ARTEC GmbH in Munich, Germany. ARTEC is a joint-venture of KNDS Deutschland GmbH & Co. KG, Rheinmetall Landsysteme GmbH and Rheinmetall Defence Nederland B.V. It is the prime contractor responsible for the BOXER Programme, the co-ordination of series production and the focal point for export opportunities. By December 2025, more than 2,000 BOXER vehicles had been contracted. Further large-scale projects are in the pipeline.

In the role of In-Service Support Engineer for the BOXER program you are responsible to support international costumers and the representative agency, NATO Support and Procurement Agency (NSPA), during the In-Service support phase of the leading multi-national 8x8 military armoured vehicle. At the industry consortium ARTEC, all technical and cross-discipline activities are focused on making a good product even better to protect the future and security of Europe and Worldwide.

Parts of the BOXER of ISS Project Engineer role:

- Preparation, execution and completion of follow-up for meetings with prime contractors and customers within the scope In-Service Support phase
- Attending and supporting regularly held customer meetings (Multinational Configuration Control Board, Logistic Control Board etc.)
- Monitoring and tracking the Engineering and Logistical Change Proposals and other deliveries under the continuous service
- Supporting in the preparation of periodic reports (quarterly progress reports, risk reports etc.)
- Supporting the offer preparation process for the Service on Request from the customer
- Coordination of ARTEC`s Main Subcontractors
- Ensuring coordination between the departments of ARTEC that have responsibilities within the scope of In-Service Support phase
- Continuous improvement of processes and monitoring of KPIs
- Supporting and deputizing the In-Service Support Manager of ARTEC
- Bachelor's degree, engineer, technician or comparable qualification
- Previous experience in customer support and/or with the NSPA is advantageous
- Basic understanding of ILS sub-disciplines and their interaction with each other
- Basic understanding of Configuration Management process
- Experience in contract management is advantageous
- Strong organizational and communication skills
- Ability to quickly understand and facilitate complex technical relations
- Hands on mentality
- Business fluent in English written and spoken
- Strong scheduling/ planning skills

ARTEC is characterized by a flat hierarchy with a project-matrix organisation. This provides the opportunity for you as BOXER ISS Project Engineer to work on a international project with different team members from different countries at the same time.

The office is located in Munich - the most liveable city in Germany.

- Interesting and varied opportunities in a leading role for large scale and demanding International and National projects across the whole life cycle (development, series production, In-Service Support) of a state-of-the art military vehicle.
- Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth within the organization.
- Individual training opportunities offered by externals as well as a consortium owned academy.
- An office that is easily accessible by public or private transport within Munich.
- Attractive payment package and pension.
- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family.
- Flexible working hours incl. 40% mobile working possible as a standard.
- Wide range of corporate benefits.
- Offsite and team building events to underline the modern working environment.
- Medical service at the location.
- Job Bike.
- Subsidized D-Ticket.
- Access to EGYM Wellpass.

jobs.description:
Structural Engineer (all genders) - Material Testing & Structural Validation
Help Accelerate Industrial Decarbonization

Join exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.

As our Structural Engineer – Material Testing & Structural Validation, you'll play a key role in developing the lightweight structural systems that make GlassPoint's technology reliable, safe, and scalable.

Working closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams, you'll combine advanced engineering analysis with hands-on testing to validate innovative designs and ensure they perform under real-world conditions. From small-scale material characterization to full-scale component testing, your work will directly influence the next generation of technology.
 

Your Impact

The structures you validate will become part of some of the world's largest industrial solar thermal plants, helping heavy industry reduce emissions while improving energy security.

You'll combine engineering theory with practical experimentation, transforming test results into optimized designs and helping GlassPoint continuously improve the performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of its technology.

What You'll Do

Design & Improve Structural Systems

- Analyze and optimize lightweight structural systems, components, and structural connections.
- Evaluate the behavior of steel, aluminum, composite materials, and ETFE film systems.
- Support the development of innovative structural concepts for industrial solar thermal applications.
- Transform engineering insights into scalable, manufacturable design improvements.

Lead Material & Component Testing

- Plan, build, execute, and evaluate material and component tests.
- Design and instrument full-scale structural testing.
- Conduct small-specimen material testing to characterize material behavior.
- Analyze test results and translate findings into engineering recommendations.

Develop & Validate Engineering Models

- Develop, calibrate, and improve nonlinear finite element (FEA) models.
- Predict structural behavior using numerical simulations.
- Validate simulation results through physical testing.
- Continuously refine engineering models to improve design accuracy.

Collaborate Across Engineering

- Work closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams.
- Support design decisions through data-driven engineering.
- Contribute to solving complex structural challenges across international projects.
- Share technical expertise and help drive continuous innovation.

Who You Are

You're someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges and turning analysis into practical solutions.

You combine analytical thinking with a hands-on mindset and enjoy moving between simulations, laboratory testing, and real-world engineering. You're curious, collaborative, and motivated by seeing your work become part of technologies that make a global impact.

Ideally, you'll bring:

- A degree in Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline (ideally with a background in construction, civil engineering, or automotive engineering).
- Several years of experience in structural, material, or component testing.
- Experience working with nonlinear material behavior and structural analysis.
- Strong experience with numerical modelling and nonlinear FEA.
- Hands-on experience planning and executing engineering tests.
- Familiarity with sensors, instrumentation, and measurement systems.
- A structured, analytical, and independent working style.
- Confidence working in an international engineering environment.
- Excellent English communication skills; German is an advantage.
- Experience with foundation systems for solar structures, soil testing, rammed piles, ground screws, or percussion drilling is a plus.
What You'll Find at GlassPoint

- Real ownership and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact from day one.
- Exceptional colleagues from diverse disciplines who challenge, support, and learn from each other.
- Complex challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.
- An international team united by a shared purpose and ambitious goals.
- The adventure of helping build the future of industrial decarbonization.
 
We value inclusion and foster a culture of belonging, welcoming team members of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, gender identity, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We have zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation.
 

GlassPoint helps heavy industry decarbonize by replacing fuel-based steam with solar thermal heat. This reduces energy costs and improves long-term energy security.  We’re a proven technology, already operating some of the world’s largest solar steam projects across sun-belt regions in oil and gas, metals, and mining.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

We are seeking a technical and innovative professional to drive the hands-on implementation, 
automation, and optimization of GS C P SQD’s digital infrastructure. In this role, you will lead the 
technical deployment of IT tools, data engineering solutions, and AI applications to build a robust, 
scalable, and resilient supplier quality ecosystem. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the technical implementation, configuration, and development of GS C P SQD digitalization projects
* Deep dive into IT toolsets to customize, integrate, and optimize supplier quality software and platforms
* Build and maintain robust data pipelines to ensure flawless data quality, integrity, and synchronization across all systems
* Develop and maintain dynamic KPI dashboards, predictive reporting frameworks, and AI driven solutions to enhance decision-making and process performance
* Translate supplier quality process requirements into standardized, scalable digital workflows that drive efficiency and consistency; Act as the primary technical interface for IT-related topics, providing troubleshooting, advanced tool training, and digital enablement support for global users
* Translate global strategies into practical digital solutions that support supplier quality objectives; Collaborate closely across product lines, regions, central IT departments, and global SQ teams, to ensure system compatibility, knowledge sharing, and smooth solution rollouts.

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or an Engineering/Supply Chain discipline with a strong software focus
* Proven experience in data analytics, database management, BI tools (Power BI, Tableau), and automation platforms
* Hands-on experience or familiarity with programming languages and applying AI/Machine Learning models to business processes
* Strong understanding of how digital tools apply to Supply Chain, Procurement, or Supplier Quality processes
* Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to explain complex digital solutions to non-technical global teams
* Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
